# A09-S97: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

The article in Jyllands-Posten comes Monday or Tuesday next week. We got
some great pictures taken! Transformator is also coming next week. I got
explained MindFuture and the eighteenth thoroughly in both, so I hope it also
gets a prominent placement.

Regarding Vestegnen's Culture Week, I have been preparing the application to Høje
Taastrup Municipality, but - tada - their meeting calendar with the last Tuesday of
the month does not apply for June AND July. They could have at least informed
you. But well, it can still be done, so I have to send it off in good time,
so we are at the top of the pile - but we probably won't get a response until sometime in
August at the earliest.

[…]
